subject: Regression on the zero part for the zeroinflatedpoission1

messages.author: d35e483a32894a6c
messages.subject: Regression on the zero part for the zeroinflatedpoission1
parts:
Hi, guys,

I want to model the zero part of the zeroinflatedpoission1 model with regression. It seems not work now. Is there anyway to change the module formulation to make it possible? 

Thanks
Sunny

messages.author: 66ed4f72a898a51c
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Regression on the zero part for the zeroinflatedpoission1
parts: I'm not sure. Maybe with the 'zeroinflatedpoisson0' instead. You can define a new outcome as zero when the original outcome is zero and one if positive. Them define a second new outcome to be NA when the original outcome is zero and the actual value of the original outcome when it is positive.

messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Regression on the zero part for the zeroinflatedpoission1
parts:
if you want to put a regression model into the prob(zero) you'll need
to use the type0 one. otherwise the observation have two linear
predictors.
